description: Read the current device clipboard text, or replace its contents with the given text. Android runs both through the clipboard service shell command, and a build that implements none (Android 16 does not) refuses with UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION rather than reporting an empty clipboard. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

text.description: Text for write; required for write ("" clears the clipboard), refused for read.

name: clipboard
